title: kv-cache: adaptive spillover + defrag scheduling heuristics (v33)
author: Ethan Liu
body: Summary: This PR implements v33 of the KV cache memory-management and eviction heuristics. Motivation: we observed increased fragmentation and spillover during mixed-length continuous-batching workloads which caused p99 latency spikes and higher GPU memory churn. This change set introduces an adaptive spillover threshold, prioritized defragmentation scheduling, and a lightweight per-allocation age+size scoring function to improve in-place compaction decisions. The goals are to reduce spillover frequency, lower memory fragmentation, and avoid long stop-the-world compaction pauses while preserving throughput. Changes include: - Adaptive spillover: dynamically adjusts spill thresholds per-shard based on recent allocation/eviction patterns and incoming sequence-length distribution; favors delaying spill for hot shards with frequent reuse. - Defrag scheduler: background scheduler that prioritizes small, high-fragmentation regions and spreads compaction work across idle windows to avoid latency cliffs. Includes backoff for heavy-throughput periods. - Scoring heuristic: per-allocation score = alpha*age + beta*fragment_contrib + gamma*size to rank candidates for eviction vs compaction. Tunable knobs exposed as runtime flags. - Lock and data-structure optimizations: reduced global lock hold-time in kv_mem_manager by introducing per-shard allocation lanes with optimistic read paths; changed compact lists to a compacting priority queue to avoid O(n) scans. - Kernel scheduling hints: expose light-weight hints from the mem manager to the scheduler so compaction work can be colocated with low-priority kernel batches to amortize cost. - Tests and benchmarks: added unit tests for scoring heuristics and an integration bench that simulates mixed-length continuous batching to measure spill frequency and p99 latency. Performance: In internal bench (mixed 4-4096 token workload, continuous batching with 64-concurrency) we observe ~12% reduction in spillover events, ~9% improvement in p99 latency, and ~18% reduction in memory churn on average. Under a heavy-short-sequence workload we saw negligible throughput impact and p50 unchanged. Backwards compatibility / rollout: flags default to off for safety. We enable via runtime config on a canary pool and plan to roll out by shard for Dedicated clusters. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-13892) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration bench added - [x] Linted and compiled on linux - [x] Benchmarks compared and validated - [x] Reviewer approvals Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the adaptive parameters behind runtime flags to allow incremental tuning. See docs/perf/kv-cache-eviction.md for tuning guidance. Related: follows work from v31/v32 (see prior PRs) and resolves regressions seen in release/2026-01 incident.
commits: refactor: split kv_mem_manager into allocator + compactor modules
feat: add adaptive_spill_threshold per-shard with EWMA estimator
feat: implement defrag_scheduler with prioritized compaction queues
perf: reduce lock contention in allocation hot path (per-shard lanes)
test: add bench/kv_cache/bench_spillover.py and integration sim
docs: add perf tuning guide for kv-cache eviction
review_comments: Priya Natarajan: Can you provide more detail on the EWMA window and initial alpha choice? Feels important for bursty workloads.
Ethan Liu: Responded: default window=64 samples, alpha=0.0625 (configurable via runtime flag). We added explanation in docs and a small unit test showing sensitivity.
Lars Johansen: I saw a transient failure in integration-kv-sim on first CI run; can you add a retry or reduce nondeterminism?
Ethan Liu: Fixed: test now seeds RNG and introduces deterministic timings. Re-ran CI and green.
Maya Chen: Approve after small nit on log verbosity during compaction to avoid log spam in production.
Ethan Liu: Addressed: reduced compaction logs to debug level and added rate-limiting for repeated messages.
ci_checks: integration-kv-sim: pass (flaky on first run, rerun passed)
merge_summary: Merged by Lars Johansen via squash on 2026-02-18 after approvals. Rollout plan: enable flags on canary Dedicated shard set and monitor kv_cache.spillover_events and mem.compaction_time. If metrics stable for 48h, progressively enable on remaining shards.
release_notes: Improved KV cache memory management and eviction heuristics: adaptive spillover thresholds, prioritized defragmentation scheduler, scoring-based eviction/compaction, and lock-contention reductions. Expect fewer spillover events and lower p99 latency under mixed-length continuous-batching workloads. Flags are off by default.
